subject: The index and manifest tables have a shape nothing checks
recordedOccasion: from breaking two of them and not noticing.
severity: low per instance, and it defeats the check a session actually runs. Every validator in the repository passed on both broken rows.
scope: instruction set. §§4c–4d define these tables; nothing validates them. Whether the *fix* belongs here is finding F3.

findings.statement: The indexes and manifests have a required column shape that no check enforces

resolution.whatWasDone: .internal/ai-scripts/session-management/verify-findings-structure.sh lines 95-116 take each table's column count from the header that opens it and report any data row that disagrees; 59 OK / 0 FAIL on this tree

findings.statement: `verify-doc-paths.sh` gives false assurance on a malformed row, because links are not shape
findings.sectionHeading: F2 — the check that runs gives the wrong assurance

findings.statement: The fix is a lint, so this bundle may be in the wrong tree
findings.sectionHeading: F3 — this may be in the wrong tree

findings.statement: A patch containing a deletion under-applies silently, and every check passes
findings.sectionHeading: F4 — a patch containing a deletion under-applies silently, and every check passes

findings.statement: Nothing compares a resolution's claim against the tree
findings.sectionHeading: F5 — nothing compares a resolution's claim against the tree

findings.statement: The prose total under an index is wrong in both directions, and the count check passes over it
findings.sectionHeading: F6 — the prose total nobody counts

decisions.decision: A check is responsible for the artifact as it will be read, not for a curated proxy of it. Where it can only see a declared subset, the undeclared remainder must fail rather than inform
decisions.sectionHeading: D1 — what the assurance layer is responsible for seeing

decisions.decision: F1 is overtaken. The column-count check was built at Revision 195 and the Bundle: value defect it later gained is clean in all ten files
This bundle stays in docs/session-management-findings/. The subject decides the tree, not the fix
decisions.sectionHeading: D3 — the tree is decided by subject

decisions.decision: F4's record half is closed by section 6. Its "and every check passes" half is D1 and is not separately decided
decisions.sectionHeading: D4 — F4 is closed on the record and open on the check

decisions.decision: A resolution names a verifiable referent — a file and a construct in it — never a section number
decisions.sectionHeading: D5 — a resolution names something grep can answer

decisions.decision: A total is summed from the rows it describes, or it is not written. The count check gains the one assertion it has always been read as making
decisions.sectionHeading: D6 — sum the column, or delete the sentence

edges.why: both ask what verify-doc-paths is responsible for covering; one answer settles the shape of the check and the other its reach
